name: search / on_search

notes: Core transaction grammar, domain-agnostic.

name: select / on_select
real_world_capability: Provisionally construct an order and get a live quote back

name: init / confirm
real_world_capability: Lock in terms and place an order, triggering fulfilment

name: status / track
real_world_capability: Pull current order state and live fulfilment/shipment tracking

name: update / cancel
real_world_capability: Modify or cancel an order post-confirm

name: rating / support
real_world_capability: Rate a completed transaction; escalate to order-specific support

name: Retail domains (RET10-15)
real_world_capability: Discover/order groceries, food, fashion, electronics, home goods, beauty products across any listed seller
notes: Production-live.

name: Logistics (LOG)
real_world_capability: Book courier/freight capacity from any listed logistics provider, domestic and international, B2B

name: Ride hailing (TRV10)
real_world_capability: Book any listed cab/auto from one interface, no app-switching

name: Metro/bus unreserved (TRV11)
real_world_capability: Discover and buy transit tickets city-wide from one interface

name: Intercity bus / airline / hotel / heritage entry (TRV12-14)

notes: Draft-stage beyond ride-hailing.

name: Financial Services (FIS)
real_world_capability: Discover/apply for credit, insurance and other financial products across listed NBFCs/insurers from one interface
notes: Mostly draft-stage.

name: IGM (Issue & Grievance Mgmt)

name: RSF (Reconciliation & Settlement)
real_world_capability: Standardised ledger of what is owed between network participants post-transaction

name: Workflow Service
real_world_capability: Model any multi-step approval/application process generically, config-driven, no code per new process
notes: The reusable pattern — a universal process-modelling grammar.

name: Registries (Individual/Property/HRMS/Boundary)
real_world_capability: Authoritative, real-time, consent-gated lookup of a person/asset/place as single source of truth

name: Notification Service
real_world_capability: Trigger SMS/email at any workflow state transition, localized

name: HRMS

notes: egov-hrms/employees/_create, /_search endpoints documented.

name: Citizen Complaint Resolution (PGR)

notes: /requests/_create, /_search, /_update endpoints documented.

name: Residential Construction Permit
real_world_capability: Apply for and track a building permit end-to-end

name: Water & Sewerage Connections
real_world_capability: Apply for/manage utility connections

name: Local Business License Issuing
real_world_capability: Apply for/renew a trade license

name: Birth & Death Certificate Issuance
real_world_capability: Request vital-event certificates

name: Property Tax System
real_world_capability: Assess, bill, and collect property tax

name: mCollect

name: Waste Management System
real_world_capability: Route/track municipal waste collection

name: Health Campaign Management (HCM)
real_world_capability: Plan/execute public health campaigns at scale

name: Digital Verifiable Credentialing (DIVOC)
real_world_capability: Issue tamper-proof, verifiable digital certificates
notes: Built for COVID vaccination certs, now general-purpose.

name: Social Benefit Delivery System
real_world_capability: Administer eligibility + disbursal for welfare schemes

name: DRISTI
real_world_capability: Online dispute resolution for courts

name: MOSIP identity stack
real_world_capability: Build a national or org-level digital identity + authentication system without starting from scratch
notes: DPG-certified, adopted 10+ countries.

name: eSignet module
real_world_capability: Single sign-on against a country's own digital identity platform
notes: Infosys-contributed module.

name: Infosys Springboard
real_world_capability: Deploy free multi-language skilling courseware infrastructure at scale

name: GHO OData API
real_world_capability: Query 2,300+ published global-health indicators across 245 countries/regions programmatically
notes: Current implementation scheduled for replacement near end of 2025 — verify before building on it.

name: Athena API (legacy)
real_world_capability: Same underlying health-indicator data via an older query grammar
notes: WHO explicitly states this is no longer maintained; still returns data — the textbook "hidden in plain sight" case.

name: ICD-11 API
real_world_capability: Look up/validate diagnosis codes; build clinical or health-data tooling that speaks ICD-11

name: World Bank Open Data API
real_world_capability: Pull GDP, poverty, demographic, climate indicator series by country/year, including India

name: RapidPro flow engine
real_world_capability: Build a low-bandwidth conversational service (health reminders, agri advisories, grievance intake) reachable on basic phones via SMS/USSD/voice
notes: Already used in several India state programs. No-code flow builder.

name: Humanitarian Data Exchange
real_world_capability: Pull structured crisis/vulnerability/disaster-response datasets instead of scraping news
notes: India-relevant subsets exist (disaster, refugee, food security).

name: OpenSPP platform
real_world_capability: Build a beneficiary registry + eligibility + payout system for any welfare-style program, not limited to government

name: Community Health Toolkit
real_world_capability: Build an offline-first frontline community-health-worker workflow app usable with poor connectivity

name: Mojaloop payment switch
real_world_capability: Build interoperable real-time payment rails for a closed ecosystem (local currency, loyalty network, cooperative)
notes: Reference implementation of a UPI-like switch.

name: API Setu directory
real_world_capability: Single aggregator/directory to citizen-identity and records APIs: Aadhaar, PAN, GSTN, DigiLocker, Sarathi, VAHAN, PMJAY, PM-KISAN, India Post
notes: Some services publicly callable today (CoWIN, ABHA, VAHAN lookup, PIN code, GSTN search); others require regulated-entity onboarding. Highest-value single addition from the v2 pass — turns identity verification from bespoke integration into directory lookup.

name: Bhuvan API
real_world_capability: Programmatic access to India's own satellite/geospatial data: land use, disaster monitoring, thematic maps, district-level codes
notes: Government-run, functional, but documentation is sparse/dated — genuinely hidden in plain sight. Direct relevance to pollution/environment/energy problem bucket.

name: IUDX data exchange
real_world_capability: Open-standard data exchange layer for city/ULB data: traffic, air quality, water, waste
notes: Purpose-built for the noise/pollution/urban-environment bucket. Several cities publish live datasets.

name: Bhashini ASR/MT/TTS models
real_world_capability: Add multilingual voice/text interfaces across Indian languages without building translation from scratch
notes: Actively expanding. Reusable across pedagogy and service-access solutions.

name: OGD Platform India datasets
real_world_capability: Query the central catalogue of datasets published by every ministry/department
notes: Platform is alive; individual dataset freshness ranges from live to years-stale. Check per dataset.

name: Sunbird stack
real_world_capability: Deploy a content repository, learning analytics, and credentialing infrastructure for education at scale
notes: India-origin, DPG-certified, underlies DIKSHA (national teacher/student platform).

name: OpenCRVS
real_world_capability: Open-source civil registration system for births/deaths, alternative lens to DIGIT's own product
notes: Active globally; limited verified direct India deployment so far.

name: Apache Fineract / Mifos X
real_world_capability: Build a lending/savings-product backend without a bank's core-banking cost, built for microfinance/financial inclusion
notes: Relevant to investing/portfolio tooling interests.

name: Open Data Kit (ODK)
real_world_capability: Collect structured field data offline-first on mobile, sync when connected
notes: Underlies a large share of India's own NGO/survey data pipelines.

name: KoboToolbox
real_world_capability: Form-based structured data collection for humanitarian/research use
notes: Same use case as ODK, different ecosystem.

name: OpenMRS / Bahmni EMR
real_world_capability: Run a clinic-scale electronic medical record backend
notes: Bahmni is India-origin (Thoughtworks + collaborators).

name: Primero / CPIMS+
real_world_capability: Run case management for child-protection services
notes: UNICEF-backed. Niche but real, protective-services angle.

name: OpenClimate
real_world_capability: Track emissions accounting by jurisdiction on an open climate-data platform
notes: Newer, less battle-tested than the rest of the dragnet.

name: SEPAL (FAO)
real_world_capability: Run satellite-imagery-based land monitoring in the cloud
notes: Alternative/complement to Bhuvan, globally maintained by FAO.

name: X-Road
real_world_capability: Design a secure, interoperable data-exchange layer between independent systems
notes: Architectural reference (Estonia-origin), not India-deployed but codebase usable anywhere.

name: GeM (Government e-Marketplace)
real_world_capability: Discover/bid on government procurement opportunities; TCS is current SI rebuilding it on open-API architecture
notes: Government-owned platform, not a TCS public good; included because govt-as-customer is a relevant angle.

name: TCS DigiGOV suite
real_world_capability: TCS's internal IP for building/operating govt mission-mode systems
notes: Not directly usable by outsiders. Logged so it is not chased again.

name: Aadhaar Authentication API
real_world_capability: Confirm a person is who they claim to be via biometric or OTP match against UIDAI's central registry, without the requesting entity ever seeing the underlying biometric
notes: Direct access requires AUA/sub-AUA licensing; most builders integrate via a licensed KUA/sub-AUA partner rather than UIDAI directly.

name: Aadhaar eKYC API
real_world_capability: Pull a resident's verified name, address, DOB, gender, and photo electronically with consent, replacing physical document KYC
notes: Requires KUA (KYC User Agency) status — an eligibility tier above basic authentication access. Response is UIDAI-signed, legally equivalent to the physical Aadhaar letter.

name: Aadhaar offline verification (XML / Secure QR / e-Aadhaar)
real_world_capability: Verify identity from a resident-downloaded, digitally-signed document without any live call to UIDAI — no AUA/KUA licensing needed to consume it
notes: The one Aadhaar-adjacent capability an unlicensed builder can use directly: validate a UIDAI digital signature locally. No PID capture, no live UIDAI dependency.

name: UPI real-time transfer (P2P / P2M)
real_world_capability: Move money instantly between any two bank accounts using a human-readable payment address instead of account/IFSC numbers
notes: No direct public API — integration is via a licensed Payment Aggregator/PSP (e.g. Setu, Cashfree) or by becoming a bank-sponsored TPAP. NPCI's May 2025 API guidelines (OC-215) impose strict rate limits on status checks and merchant-list calls.

name: UPI AutoPay (recurring mandates)
real_world_capability: Set up recurring, pre-authorised debits (subscriptions, SIPs, EMIs) without a card network
notes: Relevant to your options/rent-collection portfolio tooling if ever building a subscription or recurring-fee product.

name: AePS (Aadhaar-enabled Payment System)
real_world_capability: Withdraw cash, check balance, or make a merchant payment using only a fingerprint and Aadhaar number — no card, no smartphone required
notes: The financial-inclusion-relevant UPI-adjacent rail — matters for rural/low-smartphone-penetration solutions.

name: DigiLocker document pull (Requester API)
real_world_capability: Fetch a citizen's government-issued documents (PAN, driving license, marksheets, vehicle RC, etc.) directly from the issuing authority with their consent, skipping upload-and-manually-verify flows
notes: Needs MeitY approval as a Requester entity. ~950 crore documents stored, ~67 crore users as of March 2026 — genuinely at population scale.

name: DigiLocker citizen app
real_world_capability: Store and share verified copies of your own documents from a phone, usable without any special registration
notes: The consumer-facing half — no approval needed, unlike the Requester API.

name: Account Aggregator consent-based data flow
real_world_capability: Let a user consent, once, to share financial data (bank statements, tax returns, investment holdings) from one regulated institution to another for a specific purpose and time window — data-blind to the aggregator itself
notes: 2.61+ billion accounts enabled as of Dec 2025. Direct FIU (data-consumer) access requires RBI/SEBI/IRDAI/PFRDA regulation; unregulated builders access it by partnering with a regulated FIU. Directly relevant to your dividend/options portfolio tooling if ever aggregating a user's holdings across brokers.

name: ABDM Health ID + consent-based health record exchange
real_world_capability: Give a patient a portable, unique health ID and let them consent to sharing specific health records between providers, instead of records being siloed per hospital
notes: The health-layer counterpart to Account Aggregator's financial-data model — same consent-architecture pattern, different regulator (NHA vs RBI).
